Definition: from G2316 and G5384; friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian:--Theophilus.
BiblicalUsage: Theophilus is the man to whom Luke addressed both his Gospel and the book of Acts. In Luke 1:3, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus. The fuller story is told on the Theophilus profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Theophilus belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing. That is why I read Luke’s two volumes as one story addressed to a real man.
